title: 5 Days & 4 Nights Yoga Retreat in Ubud Bali
metaTitle: 5 Days Yoga Retreat in Ubud Bali Indonesia
metaDescription: Yoga Retreat in Ubud Bali with daily yoga classes and Sound Healing, Reiki Healing, and daily Balinese massages. Make your holiday truly rejuvenating.
summary: A 5 days & 4 nights yoga retreat in Ubud with daily yoga classes, daily healing classes and Balinese massage treatment.
intro: Unwind yourself under the sun in our gardens with 2 swimming pools surrounded by the green, as you enjoy each and every moment during your Yoga holiday in Bali.

You will be having daily yoga classes as well as daily healing classes and Balinese massage treatment in our spa. Yoga instructors at Bali Yoga School teach authentic and personalised yoga lessons according to your condition and experience. The 5 day yoga retreat in Bali enables you to integrate the benefits of authentic yoga practices with our professional sound and reiki healers.
Our teachers possess the ancient knowledge and modern yoga teaching methods to offer classes for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels for yoga practitioners.

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: Check Out — Last day before 12:00 pm

The best and most convenient way to travel to Bali Yoga School is to take a flight to Denpasar Bali airport. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 km away from our school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to meet you from Denpasar Bali airport and drive to the school. (Pick-up service is with a little extra cost)

issues: Intro says 'You will be staying our private room' although a twin-share option is also sold (trimmed from intro).
Intro claims 'the top leading yoga school in Bali' and 'We guarantee you a completely refreshing experience' — unverified marketing claims, not used.
Inclusions use a shorter wording than the 7–11 day Ubud pages (e.g. 'Three nutritious vegan/vegetarian meals daily', 'Course materials: BYS bag, BYS t-shirt, notebook, pen, mala').
Meta description says 'daily Balinese massages' — consistent with schedule (Days 1–4) and '4 full-body Balinese massages' inclusion.
Meal timings list dinner 19:30 – 20:30 but the daily schedule shows dinner at 7:00 pm.
Meal note says 'Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays' while the retreat runs year-round with lunch and dinner on every schedule day and '3 meals a day' in inclusions — verify Sunday meals.
No retreat-specific policies (booking deposit / refund) on this Ubud page, unlike the Uluwatu pages.
Hub /yoga-retreats-in-bali/ says 'vegan meals'; this page says 'vegan/vegetarian'.
Founder section (Yogi Himanshu) contains unverifiable superlatives ('the most honest, hard-working, authentic person we can ever meet') — not extracted.
Page ends with a 'Yoga Retreats in Rishikesh, India – Learn More' cross-sell block (skipped; link target not captured).
